an5.158:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu sārajjaṃ okkanto hoti.
an5.158:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu assaddho hoti, dussīlo hoti, appassuto hoti, kusīto hoti, duppañño hoti.
an5.158:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu sārajjaṃ okkanto hoti.
an5.158:2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu visārado hoti.
an5.158:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhaviriyo hoti, paññavā hoti.
an5.158:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu visārado hotīti.
